response.sql:
WITH group_rates AS (
  SELECT
    s.riskeval,
    AVG(sc.gbsize / sc.spanmin) AS rate
  FROM scans AS sc
  JOIN sites AS s
    ON s.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref
  WHERE sc.gbsize IS NOT NULL
    AND sc.spanmin IS NOT NULL
    AND sc.spanmin <> 0
  GROUP BY s.riskeval
),
benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(rate) AS avg_rate
  FROM group_rates
)
SELECT
  AVG(gr.rate) AS avg_above_benchmark_rate,
  AVG(gr.rate - b.avg_rate) AS avg_excess_over_benchmark
FROM group_rates AS gr
CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b
WHERE gr.rate > b.avg_rate;

assumptions.assumption: SQLite's AVG ignores NULL risk evaluations, so they form one group; scans without a usable GB-per-minute ratio do not contribute to a group's rate.
